item.title: Lucky for None in Space: The solo RPG that demands a d13
item.description: Explore the galaxy and try not to die in Lucky for None in Space. Beyond Cataclysm Games returns to Kickstarter with a comedy-horror solo RPG that uses a d13.

item.title: HBO greenlights Baldur’s Gate 3 series with Craig Mazin but leaves Larian Studios behind
item.description: HBO has greenlit a Baldur’s Gate 3 TV series with Craig Mazin, but original developers Larian Studios are not involved.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #347
item.description: From Baldur's Gate III screen adaptations to the massive Zine Month crowdfunding surge, get your essential weekly summary of roleplaying games news.

item.title: Cuddly carnage: A definitive ranking of the Warhammer plushies
item.description: We rank the latest Warhammer plushies from Merchoid, from iconic Servo Skulls to mischievous Nurglings. Find out which grimdark icons make the best companions.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast #320: Samurai, Spielberg, and Shoggoths
item.description: Samurai, Spielberg, and Shoggoths! Audio EXP #320 brings you the week’s top geek news, including the Women in Games Manifesto, HBO's Baldur's Gate 3 series, and new releases for Dungeon Crawl Classics.

item.title: Empire of Bones: The nightmare sequel to The Painted Wastelands
item.description: Agamemnon Press returns with Empire of Bones, a jumbo-sized hexcrawl sequel to The Painted Wastelands. Explore the Unholy City of Zeb and back the campaign before February 17th.

item.title: Is Superheroic Fantasy D&D’s Future? A Complete Class Compendium Conversation
item.description: Let’s look at the compendium, give my impressions, and talk to its creator about whether he wrote superheroic fantasy or the reader is reinterpreting his work.

item.title: Mondo reveals limited edition Beast figure from X-Men: The Animated Series
item.description: Mondo announces a limited 1/6 scale Beast figure inspired by X-Men: The Animated Series, featuring swappable portraits and accessories.

item.title: Human Gorilla Heists: The Job Is On
item.description: Pull off the perfect fantasy heist with the Human Gorilla Heists Bundle. Get Ogre’s 11, Tools of the Trade, and the Unusual Suspects Omnibus for just $9.95.

item.title: You’re a Wizard Stuck in a Can of Beans: It does exactly what it says on the tin
item.description: Escape a tin of expired legumes in You’re a Wizard Stuck in a Can of Beans. This Zine Quest RPG by Lorena Torres Loaiza is a pocket maze zine for solo play
